text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I can't sleep at all...! Did the pressure 
points not work? Drinking hot water now 
would have the opposite effect...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—If it's come to this, it's time for a 
change of perspective.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To prepare for the future, I'll research 
new methods to fall asleep thoroughly! I 
won't make the same mistake again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce gave up on falling asleep 
and ended up staying up all night...
